findings.criterion: Supported PPTX export preserves complete report hierarchy and meaning
findings.finding: Every fresh exported PPTX retains headline, KPI, narrative, decision and next-step strings in the editable package structure, but the qualified LibreOffice raster omits or clips their visible values. The same behavior occurs in the five accepted CHG-181 R2 baseline decks under the same renderer, so it is inherited rather than a new source regression. It still fails the user outcome/export gate. Charts and tables render; the fresh RCA spatial wafer and Process Flow are visible.
findings.smallest_fix_scope: Governed PPTX text-box export layout and raster regression coverage for headline/context, KPI/comparison, narrative/evidence, risk/decision, next-step, including text contrast and containment. Do not redesign non-export Product surfaces as part of this fix.

findings.criterion: Narrow reading keeps long values, evidence and flow readable without clipping
findings.finding: At a 320 px reading width, the capacity comparison values 120000 and 142000 wrap so the last zero falls onto a separate line. The horizontal four-step allocation flow is reduced to very small labels, and the multi-column evidence table shows only part of its right side without an obvious visual scroll cue.
findings.smallest_fix_scope: Responsive numeric comparison sizing/wrapping and narrow-width Process Flow composition; preserve a discoverable, keyboard-operable table scroll affordance. Verify at the recorded 320/390 widths.

findings.criterion: Incompatible destination data blocks with a truthful, actionable diagnostic
findings.finding: Apply is disabled, so no invalid remap occurs. With the text-valued destination for numeric Failure count, the dialog exposes generic Column 1/Column 2 choices and says required source fields are missing / Failure count field not found. It does not explain the visible type incompatibility or preserve recognizable destination header names.
findings.smallest_fix_scope: Remap field inspection and diagnostics: retain pasted header identity; distinguish exact-name/type mismatch from missing field; say which target role is incompatible and why; keep Apply blocked. Add focused same-name wrong-type and missing-name evidence cases in a later governed fix.

findings.criterion: Fresh complete reports demonstrate principal-designer-quality art direction beyond correct automatic arrangement
findings.finding: Across the five fresh genres the eye is still led by the same numbered section stack, neutral bordered cards, generic line/box chart and table grammar, and repeated risk/next-step callouts. Relative to accepted CHG-181 R2 there is no obvious positive-EV improvement in report character, visual hierarchy or content-specific composition. The hierarchy communicates the task correctly in the browser, but it reads as a consistent template family rather than reports deliberately art-directed for each decision and data shape. This is a reasoned Visual Director assessment, not a quantified preference score.
findings.smallest_fix_scope: A separately governed whole-report composition/design-system iteration. Define role-specific typographic and density hierarchy, feature/support relationships, analytical/evidence placement, and content-driven whitespace for mixed reports; then test full report scenes across the five genres and fresh holdouts. Keep framework layout tokens and primitives.
